steps.en: Install the package and load the default local reader
steps.zh: 安装包并加载默认本地模型

steps.en: Load the reader, feature port, engine and calibration
steps.zh: 加载冻结模型、特征映射、引擎与校准

steps.en: Supply the record, question types and candidate criteria; select engine mode
steps.zh: 提供记录、问题类型与候选标准，选择引擎路径

steps.en: Return typed answers, probabilities, prediction sets and abstention flags
steps.zh: 返回有类型的答案、概率、候选集合与拒答标志

value.en: Route fixed-answer records without parsing generated prose
value.zh: 不用解析生成的文字，就能对固定选项做分流
